assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: distant parallax environment backdrop for a playable 2.5D Chinese riverside village at dawn.
Primary request: a wide landscape painting, full bleed, no interface. View across a peaceful old rural Chinese valley, distant blue-green layered mountains fading into morning mist, tiny tiled rooftops and one modest far-away hill pavilion at top right, a jade river winding through the distance, willow branches framing far corners. Soft golden early sunlight from upper left, sage greens, muted blue-gray peaks and warm ivory mist. Premium hand-painted xianxia RPG environment, atmospheric perspective and calm depth. The lower half should be softly blurred dark sage forest and blue-green mist, unobtrusive behind a playable map rendered on top. Keep architecture SMALL and distant, never giant foreground buildings. NO foreground characters, NO UI, NO text, NO logos, NO symbols or writing, NO borders, NO watermark. Landscape 3:2 composition.
